notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/f00631fcee4177e611aa740906a95c5f471a26bc.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey all[/b], 

Happy New Year everyone!!! To close out 2021 here is our final roster update for [i][b]Mutant Football League[/b][/i] in time for the Playoffs!!!

Moving forward we will be focused on developing Mutant Football League 2 for new generation console systems and PC. 
As you know Mutant Football League is a community-driven project. We are kindly asking everyone in the community to help us determine the direction of Mutant League games in the future by taking this survey. 

https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/8VKG3N9

[u]Changes:[/u]
[list]   [*]Player roster and skill rating updates for the 2021 playoffs.
[/list]

[i]Please, be advised that due to roster update, [u]we're strongly recommending to [b]start new Dynasty run after the update[/b][/u][/i]. The reason for this is many players have switched teams, some players are out for the remainder of the season, and all these changes will very likely adversely affect your current Dynasty Campaign play experience. We apologize for this and hope to have this issue resolved in MFL2.

Thank you all for the support and if you want to keep up with all the latest MFL2 News [url=https://www.mutantfootballleague.com/subscribe]please subscribe to our Newsletter[/url]!

Have a safe and happy holiday and thank you for your incredible support! Below are a few unretouched screenshots of MFL2 to ring in the new year.

notes.title: 03.08.2019 Steam Summer Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/bda35e70bf8584e1902afb77d0f9c04f69b7c100.png[/img]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
      [*]Roster updates to reflect the 2019 football season (we will have another update after final cuts - late September 2019).
      [*]Added custom camera for Onside Kick. 
      [*]Added camera shakes after brutal tackles. 
      [*]Mayhem Bowl game mode is reintroduced to the game. 
      [*]Now players can turn on/off Arena Hazards, Weather, Dirty Tricks and Game Spectate in all game modes. Game Spectate is set to OFF by default.
      [*]Added new Leaderboards categories in the Dynasty game mode (Funds, Point Scored, Passing Yards, Receiving Yards, Rushing Yards, Interceptions, Kills, 2018 Season). 
      [*]Added Leaderboard for Online Game mode (Wins, Loses, Games Played). 
      [*]Now players can turn on/off notification "Someone is looking for an online Match", this option is set to ON by default.
[/list]

[h1]Changes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
      [*]Balancing and Economy improvements in Dynasty game mode. 
      [*]Balancing AI difficulty. 
      [*]Now AI most likely will be trying to tie the game in the end of 4th quarter. 
      [*]Now in Dynasty, Custom Playbook all Formations are sorted in order of the addition. 
      [*]Now Sonic Blast Dirty Trick cannot be intercepted. 
      [*]Now RB's and QB's are more sensitive to the Catch rating. 
      [*]Now Smack talk aka pre-game speech will be shown in Halftime as well. 
      [*]Now Ref will be more inclined to call Pass Interference when the TARGETED receiver is interfered with while the ball is in the air. 
      [*]Improvement of the Dive and Hurdle animations for Demon model. 
      [*]General improvement of stability.
      [*]Various GUI improvements and text typo fixes. 
[/list]

[h1]Bug-fixes[/h1]
[list]
      [*]Fixed bug causing incorrect behavior of the Killbot (robot) model after death or explosion. 
      [*]Fixed bug preventing newly acquired Line Bashers to appear on the field despite Depth Chart position or manual substitution. 
      [*]Fixed bug preventing newly acquired player from being a starting player. 
      [*]Fixed bug that caused Depth Chart UI glitches in the Playoffs mode if it was launched right after Dynasty game mode. 
      [*]Fixed bug causing Line Bashers' Intelligence does not affect / unlock of more defense slots for Formations and Plays in Defense Playbook.
      [*]Fixed bug causing AI to use Time Warp Dirty Trick upon beginning of the 2nd half to return time on the end of the 3rd quarter. 
      [*]Fixed bug when Burn Returners weren't able to collect XP. 
      [*]Fixed various miscellaneous bugs. 
[/list]

[i]Please, be advised that due to number of changes in Dynasty game mode and roster update, [u]we're strongly recommending to [b]start new Dynasty run after update[/b][/u][/i]. 

[b]Thank you for reports and feedback![/b]

notes.title: New Release Date is October 30, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/b1283e32944494e4be63432717ba498b0bf51ce8.jpg[/img]
Hey MFL Steam community,

We've New Release Date for MUTANT Football League: Dynasty Edition. The game is launching October 30th in North American Retailers!

Thanks [url=https://comicbook.com/gaming/2018/09/19/mutant-football-league-dynasty-edition-physical-release-date/]comicbook[/url] and [url=https://www.gamingcypher.com/mutant-football-league-dynasty-edition-launching-oct-30-in-north-american-retailers/]Gaming Cypher[/url] for spreding the word.

From last time when we've officially spoke about release date in June 13th our plans have changed, but fear not most significant details are staying true to original post:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/529520/announcements/detail/1657768916932160920


[h1]So what have chnaged?[/h1]
We've new release plan for all 3 DLCs - they'll be released simultaneously on October 30th:
[list]
    [*][b][i]Dynasty Pack[/i][/b] – Become the coach and GM of your favorite MFL team. Win multiple championships to become the league’s next Dynasty. Includes player XP, roster management, team salary caps, custom playbooks, player trades, free agent signings and multiple season gameplay!
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/91461088538f419cf6a31e811ed2bed1f9b2a722.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/1e9e1c59fba5bd264a6c0bf90c29b3a4e3ea1ad1.jpg[/img][/url]
    [*][b][i]Demonic Legion Pack[/i][/b] – Includes the brand new Hell-Spawned Demons species, two additional devilish Dirty Tricks, two brand new teams, and their corresponding stadiums!
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/6ef6cfad3f888dca8e8ef7a79baefedee49903b8.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/3d5f58caaeb67c45cf309259d6e445e30c1e2df4.jpg[/img][/url]
    [*][b][i]Werewolf Rampage Pack[/i][/b] – Includes the brand new Rampaging Werewolves species, two additional ferocious Dirty Tricks, two brand new teams, and their corresponding stadiums!
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/e697c8c9fc2b7f59bbefb97ea46d5bf8a183884a.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/1b900fc9155b2499139439397f9e1e2b09607881.jpg[/img][/url]
[/list]

[h1]So what stays same as before?[/h1]
[olist]
 [*]We're still want to thank all or you who have supported us by purchasing Mutant Football League, [b]we will be giving the [b][i]Dynasty Pack[/i][/b] DLC away FREE to all existing Steam owners![/b]
 [*][b][i]TIMED exclusive[/i][/b] content will be release digitally in ~3 months  after retail release.
[/olist]

So for now, that's all news. Stay tuned for future announcements, events and see you in a [b][i]BETA Dynasty[/i][/b]!


[b]Best wishes,
The MFL Team[/b]

notes.title: Mayhem Bowl Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/f45e389f48fddebe02934adcb4ba884f091d067e.png[/img]
[h1]Run your own Mayhem Bowl with free Killadelphia Evils team![/h1]
That’s right, so get ready for the biggest game of the year because we’ve added the Killadelphia Evils team and home arena to this update and it’s all FREE!!!

[h1]But that’s not all…[/h1]
MFL players can stage their own Mayhem Bowl matchups with our new Mayhem Bowl play mode.

The new Killadelphia Evils update includes a new Evils team theme song, "It's After Midnight," performed by Lucky Boys Confusion, courtesy of Mutant League Records, the newest Indie jam to appear in Mutant Football League.

Check out our 2018 Mayhem Bowl simulation of this weekend's big game: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CLrqFFwugzQ

[h1]Additional changes:[/h1]
[list]

notes.title: 03.01.2018 Steam Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/2b02a015125080d3a3f7e48431a00dd4adbad99a.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! We had a busy December - we’ve finally certified MFL on Xbox and PS4. And right now we are working on new game mode called Dynasty. We are going to release several updates prior to Dynasty release, which will address various QoL issues you’ve reported us.

[h1]New features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Auto saves. If you leave the match via Pause Menu -> Exit. you can continue playing it later.
[*] Online match notification. If someone searches for a random online match - the notification will appear in left-top corner. If you are in a single game - you can join the online match via Pause Menu -> Join Online Match. You can continue playing single game match from the moment you left later (thanks to auto saves).
[*] New running camera mode. Game Options -> Running Camera.
[*] Roster Depth screen, which helps manage your starters. You can access it via Season dashboard or Bench screen.
[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Max quarter time is 7
[*] Improved UI in pre-snap for offense team (defense is in progress)
[*] You can check your routes before kicks too
[/list]

Also, from today it’s possible to play online matches in MFL demo. Enjoy!

notes.title: 10/19/2017 MFL STEAM UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi there! We've finally delivered another Steam update. And it has some major changes:

[h1]Game Speed[/h1]

Based on your feedback we've added Game Speed setting. It makes game faster or slower by changing some global attributes. You can switch it before each match in Team Selection screen (press X - Game Settings). We need your help to figure out what option should be default. Please, try it out and fill our survey:

[url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/RNZ7Y28]https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/RNZ7Y28[/url]

[h1]Keyboard Support[/h1]

Finally, MFL doesn't require a gamepad to play it. We've reworked all our UI and input system to add keyboard support. If you need help with keyboard bindings -  try use tutorial or go directly to the Keyboard Map screen. As always, your feedback on this feature is highly appreciated.

[h1]Other fixes and changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] More drama in Team Selection screen
[*] Rain VFX
[*] Various camera fixes
[*] AI fixes (timeouts logic, field goal logic)
[*] Various season UI fixes (schedule screen mostly)
[*] Now you have 20 seconds in online game to manage roster - after that clocks continue ticking
[*] Fix pause timer in online mode
[*] It was possible to play mini game 2 times in one game. Not anymore
[*] Fixed smack talk phrases after dirty trick play
[*] And many more less interesting fixes...
[/list]

notes.title: 10/5/2017 MFL STEAM UPDATE / CHANGE LIST
notes.notes:
All the changes & fixes to the MFL Steam build on 10/5/2017. Huge thanks to our community for all the bug reporting and feedback to help us make the game better! THANK YOU!!!

[h1]Fixed (reported by community)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Consecutive bullshit penalties  
[*]Player is fainting after he breaks a tackle  
[*]Kill QB / Kill Referee don’t stop on Galaxy Chaos field 
[*]Wrong mini-game VO if player dies because of land mine 
[*]Kicker position on kickoff after penalty. Now he is always in the middle of the field
[*]Dead players not having a tombstone 
[*]The "Fake Kick Rollout" pass play doesn't bring up receiver icons 
[*]Teams' ratings differ slightly between Play Now and Season/Playoffs 
[*]Missing referee on a field 
[*]PAT moving to the next quarter after half time, thus breaking kickoff 
[*]Timeout can stop Kill QB / Kill Referee dirty trick 
[*]Announcer says wrong line if defense calls an audible
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved position synchronization in online game. Should be noticeable if ping <= 70
[*]Various framerate optimizations
[*]More game SFX
[*]Improved Crowd SFX (react more & louder in the playoffs)
[*]Buzz Saw / Spikes hazard delay – it doesn’t instantly pop-up
[*]Depth of field for smack talk cinematics
[*]Added collision to Mutant Worm - now he is dangerous
[*]Allow injured players be on a field if nobody else left, that means you no longer can forfeit because of injured players
[*]Added rock hazard
[*]Various tutorial / UI fixes and improvements
[*]Bench has new player categories
[*]Grim Bay Attackers Roster updated
[*]20+ Backer names added
[*]Tweaks and polish on difficulty settings (playing on rough is a bit easier now)
[*]Improvements to AI in final seconds of game (AI is smarter)
[*]Video Capture / Screen blood and numbers removed from options
[/list]

[h1]In Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*]Keyboard support
[*]Online mode improvements
[*]Less tutorial & tip messaging
[*]Leaderboards
[*]Onside Kick improvements
[*]More hazards and weather effects
[*]Team Tuning
[*]Stat Tuning
[*]Arena & Hazard polish
[*]SFX Improvements
[/list]
